browserUseCli.description: browser-use==0.12.6 installed via pip (provides `browser-use`/`bu`). Pure Python — no Node/npm, no Playwright.

systemBrowser.description: An installed Chromium-family browser for CDP, or Firefox; Windows x64 geckodriver is bundled for local WebDriver automation.

install.offline: On a connected machine run `pip download browser-use==0.12.6 -d <folder>` (57 pure-python/small wheels, no Rust, no Playwright). Set BROWSER_USE_WHEELHOUSE to that folder; setup installs with pip --no-index.
install.online: If a proxy exists, setup falls back to `pip install browser-use==0.12.6`.
install.browser: NO browser or driver download needed. Chromium uses scripts/use-browser plus browser-use CDP; Firefox on Windows x64 uses the bundled pinned geckodriver.

notes: Version 1.1.2. Hardened for air-gapped machines: no telemetry, cloud, tunnels, browser download, or Windows x64 driver download. Chromium uses CDP unchanged; Firefox adds managed persistent profiles over loopback WebDriver.
